ImageDescription.value: Panoramic view of the urban landscape surrounding Chulalongkorn University in Bangkok, Thailand, photographed from an high point. The foreground features Sathit Chulalongkorn School and university buildings, including Chamchuri 9 Building and U Center Dormitory. The two prominent high-rise towers under construction on the left are part of the Block 33 development. In the distance, the skyline extends toward Siam to Pratunam Area, with numerous high-rise commercial and residential buildings. The photograph show the contrast between the university campus, established low-rise urban structures, green spaces, and the ongoing development of Bangkok's modern skyline.
